title: Upstream ds4 pin + clean CUDA build + streaming advertised
capture_method: single scripted run as dsv4 (g0_capture.sh piped via 'sudo -u dsv4 bash -s'); raw logs copied verbatim into results/glm52-gates/logs/g0/

assertions.name: upstream_pin
assertions.actual: 0a7ad776b9068348e6cb09df8cafa9cadd285298 ('Fix batched server session recovery race', 2026-07-23T09:07:10+00:00) — provenance.log lines 5-10

assertions.name: tree_clean
assertions.actual: empty (provenance.log: no lines between the status header and the next section header)

assertions.name: full_clean_rebuild_exit_0
assertions.expected: make clean removes *.o, then make cuda CUDA_ARCH=sm_121 exits 0
assertions.actual: make_clean_exit: 0 (rm list includes *.o); 16 cc -c compiles + 1 nvcc -c (ds4_cuda.cu) + 5 nvcc links, make_cuda_exit: 0 — build.log complete, no elision

assertions.name: warning_free
assertions.expected: 0 lines matching /warning/i and /error/i in full build log (cc runs with -Wall -Wextra)
assertions.actual: warnings_in_build_log: 0, errors_in_build_log: 0 (assertions.log; grep -ci over the full build.log)

assertions.name: binaries_linked_and_hashed
assertions.expected: ds4-server, ds4-bench, ds4-eval, ds4-agent exist post-rebuild with recorded sha256 prefixes
assertions.actual: binaries.log 2026-07-24T11:34:04-04:00: ds4-server dd10f3c9b99f, ds4-bench c7b39c7305e3, ds4-eval 8438ce0a758a, ds4-agent f23c7d130fcd; ls shows all four mtime 11:34, sha_exit: 0

assertions.name: help_advertises_ssd_streaming
assertions.expected: ds4-server --help exits 0 and contains '--ssd-streaming' with Metal/CUDA/ROCm wording
assertions.actual: help.log line 19: '--ssd-streaming                Metal/CUDA/ROCm: opt in to SSD-backed model streaming instead of full residency.'; help_exit: 0; invoked path recorded in log line 2

policy_notes: sha256 values recorded as 12-char prefixes: repo gitleaks config rejects full 64-char hex strings. Full hashes are reproducible on-host via sha256sum against the recorded binary paths.
The 40-char git commit SHA is recorded in full in provenance.log (git SHAs are not blocked by gitleaks).

Rebuild wall time was ~25 s (11:33:39 -> 11:34:04). Verified NOT a cache artifact: cc is plain gcc 13.3.0 (no ccache on PATH or /usr/lib/ccache), and build.log lists every compile command post-clean. The GB10's 20-core Grace CPU is simply fast at -j4 on these translation units.
known_limitations_carried_forward: Compilation does not exercise the 12 GLM 'CUDA stub called' routes; stub-free execution is asserted at G1 (DeepSeek path) and G3 (GLM path), not here.
CUDA persistent expert cache APIs are no-ops at this pin; G0 asserts build integrity only.
